# cursor_organization_group (Resource)

Manages a Cursor Enterprise Organization Group and its flat per-member monthly spending limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cursor_organization_group" "engineering" {
  name                           = "Engineering"
  monthly_spending_limit_dollars = 300
}

# Adopt SCIM-backed groups with an import block and guard them from deletion.
resource "cursor_organization_group" "contractors" {
  name                           = "Contractors"
  monthly_spending_limit_dollars = 100

  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique organization group name.

### Optional

- `monthly_spending_limit_dollars` (Number) Monthly spending limit in whole dollars for each group member. Omit to leave the group without a spending-limit override.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Organization group ID with the g_ prefix.
- `member_count` (Number) Current number of group members.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cursor_organization_group.contractors g_abc123
```
